selection.prose: Niels Zonneveld travels to Dortmund as fourth seed and a maiden European Tour champion, having claimed the Dutch Darts Championship in Maastricht on 18 October. Cameron Menzies, seeded 29th, is the lone Scotsman among the 32 qualifiers, a field ordered strictly by one-year European Tour rankings. Our first-to-six-leg model rates Zonneveld 72.5 per cent straight up, a 1.38 fair price the window rejects, so the handicap is the compliant view: Menzies receiving 3.5 legs at 1.41.

selection.prose: AFLW Round 11 begins in Adelaide on Friday with Port Adelaide, eleventh on 16 points at 78.8 per cent, hosting Collingwood, sixteenth on four points at 56.7. Both lost during Round 10, though by vastly different margins: Brisbane restricted Port to two goals from 39 entries, whereas Sydney thrashed Collingwood by 51 points at Windy Hill, 12.8 (80) against 4.5 (29). Back Port Adelaide to cover a 10.5-point line, priced 1.40.

selection.prose: Reigning premiers North Melbourne head the AFLW ladder with 36 points and a percentage of 251.9, although the club's own finals preview admits they look marginally more vulnerable during 2026. Adelaide Crows sit ninth on 20 points at 102.4 per cent and required Chloe Bown's match-winning goal to survive Gold Coast in Round 10. They meet at North Hobart Oval, Sunday, 1.05pm AEDT. North Melbourne minus 35.5 points at 1.42.

selection.prose: Hawthorn are tenth on 20 points at 101.5 per cent and still rue a one-point Round 10 loss to the Giants, sealed when Aine McDonagh missed late, having been tipped for one of the easier runs home. Essendon are seventeenth on four points at 55.6 per cent. The official finals-race preview frames this Round 11 meeting as the fixture keeping Hawthorn's September hopes breathing. Hawthorn minus 21.5 points at 1.40.

markets.basis: Expected point margin +0.00 from verified championship scores (a goal counts as three points). St Finbarrs semi-final +2 (2-12 to 0-16 v Clonakilty); Nemo Rangers semi-final +2 (1-15 to 0-16 v Carrigaline) and quarter-final +3 (1-20 to 1-17 v Castlehaven); the 2025 final between these two clubs was won by St Finbarrs 1-14 to 1-13 (+1). selection.prose: Rathgormack and The Nire contest the Waterford senior football final at Cappoquin Logistics Fraher Field on Sunday, 2:30pm, with Killian O'Sullivan refereeing. Rathgormack reached it via 1-14 to 0-15 against Gaultier after a 5-15 to 2-5 demolition of Abbeyside-Ballinacourty, though that same Abbeyside side beat them 1-11 to 1-7 in round five. The Nire accounted for Abbeyside-Ballinacourty 0-12 to 0-5 and Gaultier 2-10 to 0-13. Margins this thin are where a 3.5-point start for The Nire, at 1.43, earns its place.
